name: Secret Garden
summary: A hidden oasis unlocked immediately after defeating Rival Blue on Route 22. Accessed by walking through the trees on the right side of Route 1, directly below the entrance to Viridian City. Contains rare early spawns (Eevee, Riolu, Zorua, Pichu), multiple recovery items, and a Pokémon Nest with a Rockruff egg.

items.name: Potion (x6)
items.method: Item ball located in the top-left clearing

items.name: Max Revive (x1)
items.method: Item ball located in the bottom-left clearing

items.name: Revive (x4)
items.method: Item ball located in the top-right clearing

items.name: Super Potion (x1)
items.method: Magenta item ball located in the bottom-right (respawns daily at midnight)

items.name: Rockruff Egg
items.method: Found in the Pokémon Nest in the center of the garden (taking it reduces Karma by 5)

navigation_notes: Enter through the gap in the trees on eastern Route 1 directly below the Viridian City ledge. ⚠️ This area can be revisited anytime once unlocked, but it CANNOT be unlocked if you skip Blue on Route 22 before defeating Brock!
